caption: The drawing depicts a Victorian parlor filled with a variety of objects. The room contains two wooden rocking chairs, one positioned to the left and another to the right, and a small ornate table with a golden fringed cloth in the center foreground. On the table sits a phonograph with a large, blue-and-yellow flower-patterned horn, and a small intricately designed item. A pillow with a floral pattern and tassels lies on the floor in the front left. The room has dark red carpet with a subtle circular pattern and the wallpaper is blue with silver and lavender designs. At the back left corner, there is a wooden organ with decorative details, positioned below an arch with green and purple drapery. Above the organ, mounted animal horns are displayed. In the center, a hanging oil lamp with painted glass and fringe is suspended from the ceiling, casting light over the area. The back wall is adorned with several framed paintings and photographs, including a large landscape in the center, and smaller portraits. A mantle clock stands atop a white pedestal to the left, while a white vase filled with flowers sits nearby. On the right side of the back wall, there is a large white vase containing peacock feathers and a small American flag. A framed picture of a dog, an angled landscape painting, and a framed photo are also mounted nearby. A large brass horn extends from a device on a stand to the right. Against the back wall, curtains with green and mauve fabric hang around a window, with a blue rug and a footstool placed in front. The ceiling is beige with a swirled texture and a round plaster medallion. The right wall also features a mounted light switch and other framed art. The entire composition contains many detailed designs, with an emphasis on objects and patterns typical of late 19th-century interior decor.
title: Sitting Room
